description: Specifies whether the emoji button is enabled or disabled for the touch keyboard. When this policy is set to disabled, the emoji button on touch keyboard is disabled.

options.displayName: The OS determines when it's most appropriate to be available.
options.description: The OS determines when it's most appropriate to be available.

options.displayName: Emoji button on keyboard is always available.
options.description: Emoji button on keyboard is always available.

options.displayName: Emoji button on keyboard is always disabled.
options.description: Emoji button on keyboard is always disabled.
